title: Acceleration of AB
description: Essential: Correctly states the final expression for the acceleration of rod AB during its uniformly accelerated motion.

title: Speed of CD at t1
description: Essential: Correctly states the final expression for the speed of rod CD at the instant the external force is removed.

title: Velocity of AB at t2
description: Essential: Correctly states the final expression for the velocity of rod AB at the instant rod CD comes to rest.

title: Force Balance at t0
description: Important: Applies Newton's second law to rod CD at the instant it starts moving, equating magnetic and frictional forces.

title: Induced Current Relation
description: Important: Correctly uses motional EMF and Ohm's law to relate the velocities of the rods to the induced current in the loop.

title: Impulse-Momentum Application
description: Important: Applies the impulse-momentum theorem separately to both rods for the interval between t1 and t2.

title: Kinematics for AB
description: Optional: Correctly uses kinematic equations for uniformly accelerated motion to find velocities v0 and v1 for rod AB.

title: Sign Error in Forces
description: Pitfall: Makes a sign error in the direction of the magnetic force or friction when applying Newton's second law or impulse-momentum.

title: EMF Polarity Mistake
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly calculates the net motional EMF in the loop (e.g., wrong relative sign between contributions from the two rods).
